name: Cartajima (Spain)
description: Vertically divided green and yellow with a broad yellow fly, charged towards the fly with the crowned municipal arms of Cartajima (a castle and a tree on red within a bordure).
history: Municipal flag of Cartajima; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Cartajima arms — castle and tree on red within a bordure
